entries.label: Cascade/parallel formant voice
entries.implementationScope: Four oral resonators, glottal and noise sources;16controls.
entries.currentRelation: LPC8 learns coefficients; FOF20 and VOSIM21 use different generators.
entries.mechanism: Prescribe resonance frequencies/bandwidths and compare multiplied versus summed filter responses.

touchstones.description: Robotic Ah/Ee/Oo and a vibrato singing vowel.
Same F0/formants; only change cascade/parallel topology.

entries.label: Integer-divider PSG pulse
entries.implementationScope: Integer timer and8-step duty sequencer; optional clocked amplitude staircase.
entries.currentRelation: Pulse waveforms exist; clock-divider pitch quantization is absent.
entries.mechanism: Hardware-rate clock and integer counter determine attainable pitch and duty pattern.

touchstones.description: Quarter-duty chip lead.
Requested A440 swept through integer register steps; compare actual divider frequency.

entries.label: Clocked LFSR noise
entries.implementationScope: 15-bit long/short and maximal7-bit recurrences; fixed storage.
entries.currentRelation: Binary random noise42 is not an LFSR.
entries.mechanism: Clock a deterministic binary recurrence and select output state bits.

touchstones.description: Short-period metallic snare/hat character.
Same seed reproduces bits;7-bit recurrence repeats in127states.

entries.label: One-bit delta/DPCM playback
entries.implementationScope: Bounded generated bitstream and7-bit accumulator; no ROM assets.
entries.currentRelation: Sampling0 and quantization do not decode differential bits.
entries.mechanism: Each bit requests an upward/downward accumulator step; hold and filter reconstructed codes.

touchstones.description: Crunchy pulse/noise-burst playback.
Sine slope overload at step2 versus matched larger step; inspect ±step differences.

entries.label: Bitwise counter synthesis
entries.implementationScope: Curated uint32 formulas only; explicit wrap/mask/shift semantics.
entries.currentRelation: No existing counter-expression source.
entries.mechanism: Map integer time expressions to clocked PCM codes.

touchstones.description: One-line algorithmic chiptune texture.
Formula t at8000updates/s and8bits yields31.25Hz.

entries.label: Chebyshev coefficient-bank waveshaping
entries.implementationScope: Eight polynomial coefficients and bounded input index.
entries.currentRelation: Generic waveshaping14 exists; explicit harmonic-polynomial bank is missing.
entries.mechanism: Tn(cosθ)=cos(nθ) permits specified harmonics at unit input amplitude.

touchstones.description: Polynomial brass/index-decay pluck.
Only T5,unit cosine220Hz,bias0 gives1100Hz; lower input index introduces lower harmonics.

entries.label: Probabilistic Karplus–Strong drum
entries.implementationScope: One delay line, loss filter and random feedback sign.
entries.currentRelation: KS19 has deterministic polarity; the original random-sign recurrence is distinct.
entries.mechanism: Randomly invert individual averaged feedback updates with controllable blend probability.

touchstones.description: Noisy pitched membrane-like KS drum.
Probability endpoints approach deterministic string/sign-inverted cases; half blend decorrelates the loop.

entries.label: Direct discrete-map synthesis
entries.implementationScope: Bounded logistic/tent map; separately validated Hénon option.
entries.currentRelation: Rössler46 integrates a continuous ODE.
entries.mechanism: An iterated recurrence directly evolves audio state at a selected clock.

touchstones.description: Period-doubling buzz into irregular noise.
Logistic map parameter sweep shows fixed point,period2 and chaotic windows; show state plot.

entries.label: Kelly–Lochbaum tube tract
entries.implementationScope: 12–24positive-area tubes; loss, glottal boundary and lip radiation.
entries.currentRelation: Waveguide18 is an instrumental exciter/delay,not a tract area model.
entries.mechanism: Traveling waves scatter at adjacent tube areas/impedances.

touchstones.description: An educational early-computer-style sung vowel gesture.
Keep F0 fixed while changing area function; lengthening tract lowers resonances.

entries.label: Waveset resynthesis
entries.implementationScope: Offline zero-crossing segmentation; bounded cycle buffer and playback.
entries.currentRelation: Waveform-segment23 constructs a waveform; it does not extract source pseudo-cycles.
entries.mechanism: Repeat,reorder,reverse or substitute zero-crossing-delimited source segments.

touchstones.description: Wishart/CDP-style roughened vocal or percussive source.
Single-sine input and repeat2; then irregular speech-like input to reveal that wavesets are not guaranteed pitch periods.

entries.label: Phase-aligned formant synthesis
entries.implementationScope: Follow original phase-alignment construction; requires algorithm-specific verification.
entries.currentRelation: Window-formant22 and FOF20 are related but are not automatically PAF.
entries.mechanism: A nonlinear formant construction aligns carrier phases as the center frequency changes.

touchstones.description: Clear moving formant whistle.
Sweep formant center through harmonic boundaries and inspect continuity.

entries.label: Pitch-synchronous overlap-add
entries.implementationScope: Pitch marks,period-relative windows,independent synthesis/source clocks.
entries.currentRelation: Granular6 does not detect pitch epochs.
entries.mechanism: Reassemble aligned voiced periods at independently chosen times.

touchstones.description: Vowel pitch shift with duration held fixed.
Periodic source marks reconstructed at1× must null/near-null after alignment; change pitch without changing source traversal.

entries.label: Sinusoidal-plus-residual spectral modeling
entries.implementationScope: Tracked partial analysis plus analyzed stochastic residual; source preparation needed.
entries.currentRelation: Additive2 and phase-vocoder28 do not implement this decomposition.
entries.mechanism: Track coherent sinusoidal components and model the remaining spectral noise.

touchstones.description: Bow/noise balance of a newly generated or uploaded sustained source.
Recombine sine and residual branches; mute one branch at a time and inspect reconstruction error.

entries.label: PCA harmonic-envelope synthesis
entries.implementationScope: Analyze a documented small corpus,fit a linear basis,additive reconstruction.
entries.currentRelation: Neural latent34 is nonlinear; no learned linear envelope basis is exposed.
entries.mechanism: Principal components span harmonic amplitude trajectories.

touchstones.description: Interpolate spectral attacks through principal-component coordinates.
Retained component count versus reconstruction error; enforce documented nonnegative amplitude handling.

entries.label: Cellular-automaton waveform evolution
entries.implementationScope: Generic documented rule possible now; exact LASy waits for original rule recovery.
entries.currentRelation: Scanned29 uses a mechanical state; note-generating automata are sequencers.
entries.mechanism: Evolve cell values and read the evolving row as waveform data.

touchstones.description: Rule-dependent digital crackle or evolving cyclic texture.
Freeze evolution and scan one row; then separate evolution clock from readout clock.

entries.label: Nonlinear bowed-string interaction
entries.implementationScope: Two traveling-wave delay paths and validated friction junction.
entries.currentRelation: Physical16 and reed waveguide18 do not establish a bow-friction model.
entries.mechanism: Relative bow/string velocity controls stick-slip force and injected traveling waves.

touchstones.description: Sustained bowed tone across bow-pressure regimes.
Set bow velocity0; inspect passive decay; move bow point to change mode excitation.

entries.label: Reactive wave-digital circuit model
entries.implementationScope: One documented RC/diode or resonant circuit; real reactive state and scattering.
entries.currentRelation: Memoryless distortion and generic SVF are not a wave-digital circuit implementation.
entries.mechanism: Transform circuit relations into wave variables and interconnect passive scattering adaptors.

touchstones.description: Resonant electronic tone or circuit-shaped input.
Compare small-signal frequency response with the circuit transfer function; inspect energy decay.

entries.label: Adversarial waveform generator
entries.implementationScope: Actual generator training/weights,model provenance and evaluation required.
entries.currentRelation: Current neuralAR/latent/diffusion teaching models do not implement GAN training.
entries.mechanism: Adversarially train a generator distribution for waveform examples.

touchstones.description: Latent interpolation of a documented generated sound dataset.
Hold latent fixed for reproducibility; inspect held-out quality and latent sensitivity.

entries.label: Invertible flow audio generation
entries.implementationScope: Actual invertible model and training artifact required.
entries.currentRelation: Diffusion36 and deterministic decoder34 are different model structures.
entries.mechanism: Map a simple distribution through learned invertible transformations.

touchstones.description: Conditioned synthetic vowel/timbre samples.
Round-trip inversion and likelihood/conditioning checks for the actual model.

entries.label: Neural codec-token generation
entries.implementationScope: Codec encoder/decoder,sequence model and documented data/weights.
entries.currentRelation: A compact periodic-frame model is not a full audio codec or music generator.
entries.mechanism: Generate sequences of learned audio-codec tokens then decode them.

touchstones.description: Short controlled texture continuations.
Separate codec reconstruction loss from token-model generation behavior.

entries.label: Biquad EQ family
entries.implementationScope: One or several stable second-order sections.
entries.currentRelation: Subtractive7 embeds a filter; no independent input EQ laboratory.
entries.mechanism: Low/high-pass,band-pass,notch,peak and shelf transfer functions.

touchstones.description: Resonant synth sweep and telephone-band voice.
Impulse/swept sine shows response; unity peaking gain must pass unchanged.

entries.label: State-variable filter
entries.implementationScope: Stable integrator topology; explicit outputs and resonance bounds.
entries.currentRelation: A source-filter patch is not a general input processor.
entries.mechanism: Coupled integrator states produce simultaneous LP/BP/HP outputs.

touchstones.description: Resonant sweep on a harmonically rich source.
Compare simultaneous outputs and measured resonance; define behavior near Nyquist.

entries.label: FIR filtering
entries.implementationScope: Fixed designed taps; direct short convolution or prepared partitioned FFT.
entries.currentRelation: No arbitrary finite impulse-response processor.
entries.mechanism: Convolve with a finite coefficient kernel.

touchstones.description: Linear-phase low-pass or comb-shaped coloration.
Impulse response equals taps; symmetric taps yield constant group delay in passband.

entries.label: Allpass phase rotation
entries.implementationScope: First/second-order stable allpass.
entries.currentRelation: Dispersion appears inside sources; no isolated input allpass lesson.
entries.mechanism: Alter phase/group delay while preserving magnitude response.

touchstones.description: Transient smearing and dry/wet phase coloration.
Wet-only swept sine retains magnitude; add dry signal to reveal notches.

entries.label: Feedforward/feedback comb
entries.implementationScope: One circular delay with bounded feedback.
entries.currentRelation: KS19 and FDN45 use delay feedback internally.
entries.mechanism: Add a delayed copy or recirculate it to create regular notches/peaks.

touchstones.description: Metallic comb resonance.
Impulse train spacing equals delay; feedforward notches are equally spaced in frequency.

entries.label: Multiband crossover
entries.implementationScope: Documented complementary low/high split; phase-aware recombination.
entries.currentRelation: No independent split/recombine processor.
entries.mechanism: Partition frequency bands for separate downstream operations.

touchstones.description: Split bass warmth from bright transient processing.
Unity band gains recombine to the specified flat/aligned response.

entries.label: Delay/echo and multitap
entries.implementationScope: Circular buffer,integer/fractional reads,bounded feedback.
entries.currentRelation: Current FDN is a struck source,not a live echo.
entries.mechanism: Replay input after chosen times with feedback and wet/dry mixing.

touchstones.description: Slapback and dotted rhythmic echo.
Single impulse exposes exact delay positions and exponential feedback decay.

entries.label: Flanger
entries.implementationScope: Short modulated delay mixed with dry input; optional feedback.
entries.currentRelation: A particular modulated-delay routing,not a novel source family.
entries.mechanism: Moving delay creates moving comb notches.

touchstones.description: Jet-like sweep across broadband sound.
Stop LFO; notch spacing follows inverse delay.

entries.label: Chorus / ensemble
entries.implementationScope: One or more modulated fractional delays with longer base delay.
entries.currentRelation: Related to vibrato/flanging but differs in routing and delay scale.
entries.mechanism: Small time variations create detuned delayed copies.

touchstones.description: Wide ensemble of a single sustained tone.
Wet-only delay modulation changes instantaneous pitch; dry mix introduces beating.

entries.label: Delay-based vibrato
entries.implementationScope: Wet-only smoothly variable delay.
entries.currentRelation: Voice pitch LFO is source modulation; arbitrary-input vibrato is absent.
entries.mechanism: Derivative of delay controls pitch deviation.

touchstones.description: Slow tape-like pitch wobble.
A sine input gives measurable instantaneous-frequency modulation with little amplitude change.

entries.label: Allpass phaser
entries.implementationScope: Cascaded moving allpasses mixed with dry.
entries.currentRelation: Distinct implementation from flanger despite similar sweeping character.
entries.mechanism: Phase rotation interferes with dry signal to create moving notches.

touchstones.description: Hollow sweeping keyboard texture.
Wet-only magnitude stays nearly flat; dry addition exposes a finite notch pattern.

entries.label: Schroeder comb/allpass reverberator
entries.implementationScope: Parallel lossy combs plus allpass diffusors.
entries.currentRelation: FDN45 is not this network or a general reverb input path.
entries.mechanism: Diffuse input through recirculating comb delays and allpass stages.

touchstones.description: Early digital-room/reverb character.
Impulse response exposes delay density and decay; zero input eventually decays.

entries.label: Input-driven FDN reverberation
entries.implementationScope: Adapt the existing orthogonal feedback network for real input and stereo pickup.
entries.currentRelation: Existing45 is excited internally as a resonator.
entries.mechanism: Disperse external input among coupled delay lines with frequency-dependent loss.

touchstones.description: Dense abstract hall or resonant ambience.
Impulse energy decay follows specified loss; feedback matrix alone does not add energy.

entries.label: Convolution/impulse-response processing
entries.implementationScope: Own generated/recorded IR; partitioned convolution for long responses.
entries.currentRelation: No arbitrary source×IR convolution.
entries.mechanism: Linear convolution imposes the measured/designed impulse response.

touchstones.description: A dry click or voice through a generated room/plate-like IR.
Delta IR is identity; delayed delta shifts exactly; output impulse equals IR.

entries.label: Dynamic-range compressor
entries.implementationScope: Envelope detector,threshold/ratio/knee,gain smoothing; no hidden loudness normalizer.
entries.currentRelation: Output emergency ceiling is not a compressor lesson.
entries.mechanism: Estimate level then apply a documented level-dependent gain curve.

touchstones.description: Controlled drum punch or voice leveling.
Stepped sine levels measure threshold/ratio; burst reveals attack and release.

entries.label: Lookahead peak limiter
entries.implementationScope: Delay path plus detector and release policy; declare latency.
entries.currentRelation: Emergency soft knee is memoryless protection,not lookahead limiting.
entries.mechanism: Gain anticipates future peaks via delayed audio.

touchstones.description: Catch isolated transient peaks.
Impulse train verifies peak ceiling and fixed lookahead latency.

entries.label: Noise gate / downward expander
entries.implementationScope: Threshold,ratio,hysteresis,hold and release state.
entries.currentRelation: No level-controlled input gate.
entries.mechanism: Reduce signals below a threshold with documented timing.

touchstones.description: Remove low noise between synthetic drum hits.
Slow ramp crosses open/close thresholds; hold prevents chatter.

entries.label: Sidechain compression / ducking
entries.implementationScope: Independent control input and audible input; same detector/gain mechanism.
entries.currentRelation: Sidechain is routing,not a separate compressor invention.
entries.mechanism: One signal controls another signal’s gain.

touchstones.description: Kick-triggered sustained-pad ducking.
Silent audible input plus loud sidechain remains silent; ducking tracks control bursts.

entries.label: Transient envelope shaping
entries.implementationScope: Fast/slow envelope comparison with bounded gain.
entries.currentRelation: Distinct from merely shortening ADSR of a source.
entries.mechanism: Detect relative onset/sustain envelopes and alter their balance.

touchstones.description: Increase or soften percussion attack.
Equal-level steady sine should settle; a burst shows onset gain then recovery.

entries.label: Static distortion / rectification / wavefolding
entries.implementationScope: Expose actual transfer function on selected input.
entries.currentRelation: Waveshaping14/ADAA38 already contain several source-driven transfers.
entries.mechanism: Apply nonlinear amplitude mapping; fold/rectify/clip are distinct transfer shapes within this family.

touchstones.description: Guitar-like saturation or folded sine bell.
Sine sweep reveals generated harmonics; plot transfer curve and compare unity small-signal gain.

entries.label: Quantization and rate reduction
entries.implementationScope: Independent word length and hold clock; optional dither.
entries.currentRelation: Bit controls exist; arbitrary-input comparison is absent.
entries.mechanism: Round amplitude codes and/or hold samples at a lower update rate.

touchstones.description: Low-resolution drum crunch.
Quiet sine: bit depth changes quantization noise; update rate changes spectral images/aliasing.

entries.label: Input AM/ring modulation
entries.implementationScope: Multiply real selected input by a unipolar/bipolar modulator.
entries.currentRelation: AM9 and ring10 synthesize their own carriers.
entries.mechanism: Multiplication produces sum/difference spectral components.

touchstones.description: Ring-modulated robotic voice.
Single-tone input and sine modulator produce the expected sidebands; distinguish DC-biased AM carrier.

entries.label: Input single-sideband frequency shifting
entries.implementationScope: Real Hilbert/quadrature approximation or analytic STFT; state error/latency.
entries.currentRelation: SSB40 knows internal source quadrature; cannot simply assume that for arbitrary input.
entries.mechanism: Translate spectral components by a constantHz offset.

touchstones.description: Inharmonic bell shifting or rotating feedback tones.
Input220+440Hz shifted+100 becomes320+540,not a constant pitch ratio.

entries.label: Channel/filterbank vocoder
entries.implementationScope: Bandpass analysis envelopes modulate matching carrier bands; two sources required.
entries.currentRelation: LPC8 and phase-vocoder28 are different methods.
entries.mechanism: Transfer time-varying coarse spectral envelopes between modulator and carrier.

touchstones.description: Talking-synth texture from live or generated syllables.
Single modulator-band tone opens only its matching carrier region.

entries.label: STFT magnitude cross-synthesis
entries.implementationScope: Two framed signals; coherent windows/OLA normalization.
entries.currentRelation: The current phase-vocoder source resynthesis does not expose two-signal timbre stamping.
entries.mechanism: Combine one source’s magnitude envelope with another’s phase/carrier spectrum.

touchstones.description: Whisper/noise texture imposed on a pitched carrier.
Identical input/carrier at identity settings reconstruct within window/latency tolerance.

entries.label: Spectral freeze / mask / blur / gate
entries.implementationScope: Grouped STFT operations with clear per-mode semantics.
entries.currentRelation: Phase-vocoder28 covers source-based freeze/mask variants.
entries.mechanism: Modify analyzed bins and reconstruct via overlap-add.

touchstones.description: Frozen chord cloud or spectral erosion.
All-unity mask reconstructs; zero mask silences; frozen magnitude remains fixed.

entries.label: Pitch shifting and time stretching
entries.implementationScope: Delay-grain shifter and existing PV routes first; PSOLA as a separate later algorithm.
entries.currentRelation: Sampling and PV have related controls but not a unified arbitrary-input comparison.
entries.mechanism: Choose a stated resampling,grain or phase-coherent method for independent pitch/time changes.

touchstones.description: Octave voice/instrument shift with unchanged duration.
Impulse/pulse train checks duration and latency; harmonic input checks transposition ratio.

entries.label: Panning and stereo-width matrix
entries.implementationScope: Constant-power gains and explicit mid/side transform.
entries.currentRelation: Current worklet is dual mono.
entries.mechanism: Distribute channel energy and transform sum/difference components.

touchstones.description: Move a mono source across speakers; widen a genuine stereo fixture.
Center power and hardpan endpoints; M/S round-trip identity; mono input haszero Side.

entries.label: Dither and quantization-noise shaping
entries.implementationScope: Known dither distributions; bounded error-feedback shaper.
entries.currentRelation: Some existing bit-depth controls include dither.
entries.mechanism: Decorrelate or spectrally redistribute quantization error.

touchstones.description: Quiet fade into a low-bit output.
Quantization error correlation and band energy; same audio level and word length.

entries.label: Resampling/interpolation comparison
entries.implementationScope: Nearest,linear,cubic and finite-window sinc; proper rate-dependent cutoff.
entries.currentRelation: Interpolation appears inside sampling/wavetables.
entries.mechanism: Estimate values on a new time grid with explicit reconstruction filters.

touchstones.description: Transpose a high harmonic sample.
Sweep above the new Nyquist boundary; show images,aliasing and latency.

entries.label: One-bit PWM/PDM conversion
entries.implementationScope: Clocked pulse-width and error-accumulator density encoding with low-pass readout.
entries.currentRelation: Pulse oscillator timbre is not a one-bit DAC encoding of another signal.
entries.mechanism: Encode amplitude in pulse width or local bit density.

touchstones.description: Reconstruct a sine from a one-bit output stream.
Same source through rawbits and filtered output; vary clock and reconstruction cutoff separately.

entries.label: Constrained wave-RAM playback
entries.implementationScope: 32four-bit samples with integer read clock.
entries.currentRelation: Wavetable1/graphic24 already implement the broad family.
entries.mechanism: Constrain storage and timer/DAC separately.

touchstones.description: Game-Boy-style wave-channel bass.
Same table with held versus interpolated reads and independent4-bit quantization.

entries.label: SID-inspired hybrid routing
entries.implementationScope: Fixed3-voice routing case study,not a claimed emulator.
entries.currentRelation: Oscillators,sync,ring,ADSR and filters already exist.
entries.mechanism: Combine documented digital voice controls with a shared analog-style filter path.

touchstones.description: Sync/ring-modulated chip-like lead.
Isolate each building block; separate register precision from DAC/filter behavior.

entries.label: UPIC-like graphical trajectories
entries.implementationScope: Draw pitch/time/amplitude paths to existing sources.
entries.currentRelation: Graphic24 edits a waveform,not a graphical score.
entries.mechanism: Use graphics to specify time-varying musical control.

touchstones.description: Draw a rising glissando cloud.
A straight horizontal trace produces constantpitch; slope predicts glide rate.

entries.label: Common microphone/file/fixture input router
entries.implementationScope: Permissioned microphone,local file,generated fixtures; explicit source choice and meters.
